name: sepsis_cosim
description: Closed-loop sepsis CO-SIMULATION: the Tellurium sepsis physiology engine and an antibiotic-PK controller process exchange state every tick. The controller senses bacteremia (PB), infuses an antibiotic with a one-compartment PK, and writes the drug-killed pathogen (PT/PB) back into the engine via its parameters_in port. treat=False disables the controller for the matched untreated control.

treat.description: True = closed-loop antibiotic; False = matched untreated control

start_time_s.description: Earliest treatment onset (0 = early; larger = delayed)
